sell.metaTitle: Sell on Grainline — Earn 2× more, paid in 7 days
sell.metaDesc: Sell your rice direct to home kitchens. You set the price, we handle logistics, payment via UPI within 7 days of pickup.
sell.heroSub: Join farmers across India. We handle listings, orders, logistics, and payments — you focus on growing.
sell.benefit1Body: Set your own price per kilo. We never negotiate it down. Customers see your name, your village, your land.
sell.benefit2Body: Pickup Friday. Delivery Saturday. Money in your UPI account by Sunday evening. Every week, every order.
sell.benefit3Body: Confirm orders, update stock, check earnings — all over WhatsApp text. Nothing to install.
sell.testimonialQuote: “Mandi gave me ₹22 a kilo. Last month I sold at ₹50. My daughter is back in school.”
sell.readySub: Five short steps. Takes about 6 minutes. You can stop and resume any time.
